cards.title: Some calls home need action, not advice
cards.body: Most calls are about dinner and the neighbours. But a few things you hear on the phone mean get help now, not tomorrow.

cards.title: Chest pain or pressure
cards.body: Especially with sweating, breathlessness or pain spreading to the arm or jaw. Don't wait to see if it passes. Call 112.

cards.title: Face, arm or speech suddenly off
cards.body: Slurred words, one side of the face drooping, or one arm suddenly weak. These can be stroke signs. Time matters. Call 112 immediately.

cards.title: Confusion that's new
cards.body: If Papa suddenly isn't making sense, doesn't know where he is or sounds very different, treat it as urgent and get medical help.

cards.title: Trouble breathing or fainting
cards.body: Gasping, unable to finish a sentence, or a blackout. Get emergency help right away and make sure someone stays with them.

cards.title: Have a nearby person ready
cards.body: Save the number of a neighbour or relative who can reach them in minutes. You can't get from Bengaluru to Lucknow in ten.

cards.title: When in doubt, call for help
cards.body: Nobody gets in trouble for a false alarm. Waiting is the thing people regret. Save 112 and one local contact today.

takeaway: Chest pain, face or arm weakness, new confusion, trouble breathing or fainting means call 112 straight away.
share: Send this to every sibling who lives away from home.
